content.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are in each joint’s local frame, with angles in rad, angular velocities in rad/s, and angles interpreted as unwrapped right-hand rotations.","The tip position is requested in the right-handed world frame, where x is forward, y is left, and z is up; its unit is meters.","Both joints receive a constant applied torque of -0.3871852898179611 N·m, while joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m on the scheduled interval [0.4995, 0.5995) s.","joint_limit_by_T is a dimensionless boolean defined as whether either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
